Definition: present participle of G757; a first (in rank or power):--chief (ruler), magistrate, prince, ruler.
BiblicalUsage: A ruler, a first in rank or power, is the word for the men who run the world. The rulers gather against Peter and John, Moses is asked who made him a ruler and a judge, Nicodemus comes as a ruler of the Jews, and Jesus says now shall the prince of this world be cast out.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that rulers come in two kinds, and Jesus names them both. There are the rulers who gather against the gospel, and there is the prince of this world, who is cast out, and neither of them is the last word.
